title: Route 66 Martian Odyssey
description: An elderly man in a green coat and hat walks with a cane along a cracked Route 66 road, accompanied by a blue robot carrying a purple sphere on its back. The surreal desert landscape transitions from black-and-white geometric patterns on the left to vibrant red rock formations, cacti, and a setting sun on the right.
